name: radiation_heat_flux
title: Radiation heat flux: blackbody emission, grey-surface exchange, transmittance (function library)
summary: Three EES FUNCTIONs for thermal radiation: blackbody_spectral_radiance (Planck spectral radiance of a blackbody), q_rad (net radiant heat flux of a grey surface exchanging with isothermal surroundings, with back-radiation) and grey_transmittance (Beer-Lambert transmittance of a grey absorbing medium). Temperatures are in °C with T + 273.15 formed inside the functions.

authors: J. Stefan and L. Boltzmann (radiant heat flux)
P. Bouguer, J. H. Lambert and A. Beer (grey transmittance)
origin.notes: ht 1.2.0, commit 85e0ee6 (2025-12-07), file ht/radiation.py, MIT license, Copyright (C) 2016 Caleb Bell. The scientific basis of each relation is the original paper or book cited in its function comment block (Planck 1901; Stefan 1879 / Boltzmann 1884; Bouguer 1729 / Lambert 1760 / Beer 1852). Translation published under the CoolSolve_Library MIT license (decision D3).

verification.reference: doctest values of ht 1.2.0 ht/radiation.py (case A) and additional values computed with the same ht functions in a throw-away virtualenv (case B); 8 output values in total
verification.notes: compare_solution.py: 8 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); largest relative deviation 7.1e-14 (I_blackbody_A), i.e. round-off only.
